integrity: The exact critical-point factorization and Gram identity are proved analytically; finite executable checks corroborate these identities and large-degree limit, and are not proof for all real parameters.
scientific_limitations: Single co-located value/first-derivative jet; sharp finite global value expressed as maximum of two closed-form candidates, without a finite-n strict ranking; eventual ranking holds for each fixed beta>1; does not cover arbitrary two-node geometry. Historical priority subject to uninspected older equivalent Meixner/Christoffel formulations.
title: Two competing jet-sampling radii and a sharp Gamma boundary law for weighted Bergman monomials
